query TelemetryHourly($where: TelemetryHourlyWhereInput, $orderBy: [TelemetryHourlyOrderByInput!], $first: Int, $after: String) {
  telemetryHourly(where: $where, orderBy: $orderBy, first: $first, after: $after) {
    edges {
      node {
        id
        count
        countBad
        countFalse
        countGood
        countTrue
        distinctCount
        modeCount
        avg
        first
        last
        max
        min
        p05
        p25
        p50
        p75
        p95
        pctTrue
        std
        sum
        modeValue
        periodAt
        dataPointId
        dataPoint {
          id
          code
        }
      }
    }
  }
}
